notes.title: Juggle Masters: Krav Maga Edition
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27169947/f43dd19cd1c8df7b94389c9e0770c4c9a7825d31.png
Featuring our newest "Juggle Masters" Event!
For this edition, we'll be seeing what you can do with the Sacred Scroll "Krav Maga".
This will be a recurring event. The possibilities are endless!

Rules:

Only the following Sacred Scroll can be used: Krav Maga
Your juggle video must clearly show your in game name and user interface to prevent identity fraud.
You may not use hacks or 3rd party programs that enhance your game play, stats, or physics of the game.
You may use any various systems implemented in the training system such as training bot teleportation and modifying the training bot to do various moves.
With that said, you do not have to use training mode. You may use a human player as your juggle subject.
The human player can do things to influence your juggle like preemptively jump to start a juggle combo or attack for "counter-launchers".
Your video must be uploaded either on YouTube or Vimeo.
Your entry must be signed by your in game name in your entry post.
If you change your in game name before the prize distribution, you forfeit in game prizes rewarded.
Participation prize will be graded by effort, but ideally you will prove that you can do more than just a standard juggle combo, such as resetting your juggle combo through various platforms and terrain.
ExoCores may be used to aid your juggle, but must not take away that you must highlight using the scroll itself.
If you have more than one existing forum title, you may have to remove a forum title to make room for the new one.

If this is the case, we will request for your permission to adjust it in a forum PM.

Prizes are not tiered. You will only get the prize in your tier.

Prizes:

Grand Prize: "Krav Maga Master" Forum Title, 2500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
2nd & 3rd: "Juggle Champion" Forum Title, 1500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
Participation Prize: Krav Maga Title (30 Days)
https://i.imgur.com/lQByhcb.png

Event Duration: May 12, 2022 - June 17, 2022
Community Voting: To be determined

The best gift of the season is the Gift of Thanks.

Despite the ongoing pandemic, there's still a lot to be thankful for. Our Rumble Fighter Team, for example, is grateful for all of our players, new and old, for your continuing support and love.  We hope that you can be thankful for your fellow players as well! This Thanksgiving, share your thanks with one friend on Rumble Fighter. You can only receive and give to 1 player however, so make sure to choose the friend you are most thankful for!

Event Rules: 
Gifting and Receiving must be done between two players.  Gifting and Receiving will not count towards the event if you Gift to / Receive from multiple players.  
Players will be required to post a screenshot of their gift box AND indicate the recipient of the gift.  The gift message must contain "The Gift of Thanks" or somehow indicate that it is for this event.  Also, the IGN of the Recipient must be included in the post for clarification.  
On the forum post, please also leave a brief letter/message stating your thankfulness towards the player.  If you have gifted multiple items, please also make sure to include each gift for verification. 
Rewards will be cumulative, meaning if you qualify to receive the "Orichalcon Coupon Package", you will also qualify for the lower tiered rewards.  
Any IGN changes before event prizes are distributed MUST be mentioned via a Support Ticket. If you do not receive your prize for having changed your IGN, the prizes will be revoked and not corrected. In short, please let our staff know about the IGN change to make the necessary changes before sending out prizes.

Event Prizes: 
Gifting Rewards:
Gift 1 item of 30,000 or more Carats Value: Orichalcon (x2) & Baby Black Dragon (7 Days)

Receiving Rewards: 
Receive 1 item of 30,000 or more Carats Value: Orichalcon (x2) & Black Cheshire (7 Days)

If you Gift to and Receive from the same friend, you will also receive:
Title of Good Harvest (30 Days)
A nice surprise gift (TBD)

Event Duration:
November 23rd, 2020 00:00 PST - November 30th, 2020 23:59 PST

Prize Distribution: 
3 - 5 business days after event concludes

notes.content:

I'm not running away from the ghosts! I'm running towards the Spooktober Spender's Event!

Start your Spooktober/Halloween weekend with a ghoulish Spender's Event! Spend the required spending tiers to receive the listed prizes below. Please remember to stay safe during this year's Halloween should you decide to head out. Happy Spooktober, Fighters!

Carats Spenders Prizes:
Spend 50,000 Carats: Violence Bunny (30 Days) + Jacko Helmet 2 (30 Days)
https://i.imgur.com/6kpuapT.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/VvwWQoH.png

Every 50,000 Carats spent will receive 1 Orichalcon (Max 5)

Spenders Rules:
Only RedFox Credits and Carats spent during the event period will count towards the rewards.  RC and Carats spent before and after the time frame will not qualify towards the event.
All prizes are tiered, meaning if you reach the highest tier, you will get all the below tiers as well. For example, if you spend 3,750 RC you will receive the Banshee Hats 1/2, Golden Neko Ears, Pumpkin Lantern, and the Blue/Red Jack Caps.  The same rule will apply towards the Carats Spenders.

notes.title: Boss Mode Rush: Assault
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/9Tqexkv.png
Boss Mode Rush is back on! Claim your Battle Flags now!

Experience the Boss Mode Rush, a challenging trial where you and your team must battle against hordes of monsters while completing the objectives.  Trust us when we say that you will not get it down on your first attempt.  Grab your best gear and speed into the Boss Mode Rush.



Boss Mode Rush: Assault
Assault Mode - Defeat all of the androids (and boss) in Neo Alchemist City Boss Modes within 550 seconds under specific criteria.

https://i.imgur.com/pAfDhaL.png https://i.imgur.com/2OigChL.png https://i.imgur.com/qrcGrGi.png


D-H-14 (Hell): Boss must be defeated with the "Machine Gun" pouch item or item pickup.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, Question Title (45 Days)
https://i.imgur.com/mSzRhpT.png

D-H-SBASE (Hell): You cannot fall off the map at any time.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, So What Tee (M/F) (Permanent)
https://i.imgur.com/hW0uOP3.png https://i.imgur.com/tuEjlqO.png

D-H-CORE (Hell): All Players' HPs cannot fall below 50%.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, Exclamation TItle (45 Days)
https://i.imgur.com/OImLd0v.png

AND

Completion Prize*:  Fighter's Battle Flag
*Can receive prize if valid submission shows completion of all three maps 
https://i.imgur.com/59YJjWk.png

Event Duration: 
August 4th, 2020 00:00 PDT - August 31st, 2020 23:59 PDT

Prize Distribution: 
3 - 5 business days after the event concludes

Invincible Battle Flag and King's Battle Flag Upgrade: 
If you have two Fighter's Battle Flags, you may send in a ticket to redeem an Invincible Battle Flag. This time around, however, you may also send in a ticket to replace two Invincible Battle Flags for the next tier, King's Battle Flag. Once you have received the upgrade, the previous two flags will be removed from your inventory.

https://i.imgur.com/fGWCkei.png  https://i.imgur.com/lQYBswu.png

=========================

Players must complete the Boss Modes with a team of up to 4 players total. As stated in the Event Rules, maps must be in Hell Mode, no ExoCores, and no revives of any sorts.  We encourage players to designate one player to be in charge of recording the run(s).  In order to ensure an organized thread, please write out every players' IGN and consolidate all videos into one post. Make sure to read the rules to better understand the event.

Event Rules:

Boss Mode must be run in Hell difficulty.
No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.
The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself and other teammates is not allowed.
All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
All participants must be active in the challenge.

Event Requirements:

The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.

Submission and Event Thread Notice:

Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a separate thread that will be provided in General Discussion.
Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread.  (ie "res", "bump", etc.)

notes.content:

This Polar Bear knows how to beat the heat!

Hang 10, Fighters! Surfing polar bears are hard to come by, even rarer to embody one.  Cool off from the summer heat with a playtime event for the Polar Bear Set (30 Days) and a permanent Knu ExoCore! The event will be sectioned into four weeks, each with different parts for the Polar Bear Set and Knu.  After each week, the prizes will be distributed and the next objectives will begin.

Prizes will only be given for the requirements of that week

July 1 - 7

Play 25 Battle Mode matches - Polar Bear Hat & Head (30 Days)
Complete 3 hours of Playtime - Polar Bear Top (30 Days)

July 8 - 14

Acquire 100 Kills - Polar Bear Pants (30 Days)

notes.title: Hottest Summer Couple - Fashionista Event
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/hjDM6Gj.png
The competition is getting fired up!

Show off your coolest and most refreshing outfits for this summer’s hottest Fashionista Event! Grab your partner and plan the best summer getup to earn the rightful title as the “Hottest Summer Couple”. Bring your A-game and scorch the competition!

Event Prizes:

First Place - 1,000 RC & "Hottest Summer Couple" Forum Title & 5 Orichalcon
Second Place - 500 RC & "Hottest Runner Ups" Forum Title & 3 Orichalcon
Third Place - 50,000 Carats & 3 Orichalcon
Participation - 1 Orichalcon

Event Rules:

Take a screenshot with a partner in your best, summer outfits as a couple.  Entries must have two players (no more, no less) wearing summer related "Couple's Outfits".  (Screenshots with more or less than two players will be disqualified)
"Couple's Outfits" should have a theme and a sense of coordination between the two players.
A "Couple" can be any combination of males and/or females.
All entries must include the In-Game Names of both players in the screenshot (Limit 1 entry per account - one player cannot appear in two different entries)
Outfits must relate to the Summer theme, unless there is an explanation for why your outfit works for the theme.
Photo-editing programs are appreciated, but will not give you an advantage.
There is no need to list out items used in the outfits.
Placement prizes will be delivered as two

For example - First place winners will each get 1,000 RC, Title, and Orichalcon.

Prizes will be distributed 3 - 5 days after the event has concluded.

Event Duration:

Wednesday, June 17, 2020 00:00 PDT  -  Monday, July 20, 2020 18:00 PDT


Tips on getting the perfect picture:

Press "Page Up" to hide your UI
If you know how to use Photoshop, now is the time to show us your skills
BE CREATIVE!

You may gift items to meet your Carats spending tier.
Carats that have been used to gift another user will only have their carats apply to the original purchaser. For example if you gifted a 30,000 carat item, only you will have 30,000 carats applied towards this event.
If you did not receive your prizes but spent the correct or above amount of necessary carats, please submit a ticket and your account will be manually investigated. Once cleared, you will receive your items. If found suspicious, your account will be barred from receiving any carat spending prizes.

notes.title: [EVENT] Winter Northern Lights - Enchantment
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/yatIPwQ.png
A brilliant radiance pierces the Rumble Fighter sky!

Enchantment Part I
As a small incentive for players to enchant successfully to +10, we are giving everyone an opportunity to receive 2 Master Cards every day for one week. All you have to do is simply enchant any Gem from +1 to +5 during the Part I event period. You are limited to 2 Master Cards per day, but you can earn up to 14 cards if you successfully enchant from every day.

Part I Time Slots: 
Enchanting for Part I must take place between these times (server time)
11 AM PST - 1 PM PST

Part I Rules:
Gem used for Part I must start from +1 for each day. It does not matter which gem you use, however. 
Enchanting must happen in the time period mentioned above. 
Zircon of Health must go from +40 to +200. Tanzanite of Mana must go from +12 to +60. 
Enchanting does not need to succeed all at once. As long as your starting point is at +1 and it eventually gets to +5, it will qualify to receive 2 Master Enchant Cards.
you may continually use one gem by downgrading it and upgrading it during this time.

Part I Prizes:
2 Master Enchant Cards 
https://i.imgur.com/OymuVrW.png
Daily limit = 2 cards; Total = 14 Master Enchant Cards

Event Duration:
December 21st 11:00 PST - December 27th 13:00 PST

Prize Distribution:
3 - 5 business days after event concludes


Enchantment Part II
Event Rules:
Successfully enchant any level gem to +10 during this event period. 
Enchanting only applies to Ruby of Power (+10), Obsidian of Defense (+10), and Zircon of Health (+400). 
You may only win the main prize once during the event period.
At the end of the event, your gem must remain at +10 or +400. Any changes to it afterwards will result in a disqualification.
GMs will personally send you an email with your prize request list, so please do not send in a ticket requesting your Grand Prize.

Grand Prizes (+10 or +400):
Kuroko Black Set (base stats) (M/F)
Kuroko Red Set (base stats) (M/F)
Poseidon Set with Poseidon Spear (does not include ExoCore)
Water Elementalist Set with Poseidon Spear
RedFox Detective Set

Event Duration:
December 21th 00:00 PST - January 6th 23:59 PST

Prize Distribution:
3 - 5 business days after event concludes

For any questions regarding the event, feel free to ask on this thread or over at our Discord.  Good luck on your enchanting. Happy Holidays!

The time has come to crown the Winter Formal royalty!

Winter time calls for hot chocolate and warm clothing.  It’s also a time to show off your stylish winter fashion. Whether you want to dress stylish or extra warm, your style is a representation of who you are.  Dress the way you like for some grand rewards. Just know, that there will be only two players that will be crowned King and Queen.

Dapper up in your best winter attire and take a screenshot.  Editing of your screenshot is encouraged, but will not add any advantage in winning.

Fashionista Title (In Game Title)

1000 RC

As a token of our appreciation to our Fighters, simply login on Thanksgiving Day (PST) and play to receive a Thank You Chest and Key.  There will be a poll to see which rewards our players would like to receive.  The Chest with the majority of the votes will be chosen as the final prize.

https://i.imgur.com/TZCG6fb.png
Ascended Scrolls
Ascended Scrolls transform your favorite Sacred Scrolls by adding bonus stats on them!
You can either craft or purchase an Ascended Scroll. Purchased scrolls will have an extra HP +80, STR +5, ARM +5, SPD +3, and CRI +20, while upgraded Ascended Lv. 2 Scrolls will only have STR +5 and ARM +5.
The Ascended Scroll Box now contains an Ascended Tome and an Ascended Jade for all 68 Sacred Scrolls that are available for Ascension.
Additional stat of [HP +80] added to Ascended Scrolls purchased in the Shop; not added to Ascended Lv. 2 Scrolls.
Players can access their Ascended Scrolls in the tab called "Enhanced" in the "Skill Item" tab.

https://i.imgur.com/BHgZfER.png

How to Ascend your Sacred Scroll:
Utilize pre-existing Permanent or Timed Sacred Scrolls plus a matching Ascended Tome or Ascended Jade, which can be attained through the Ascended Scroll Box. These boxes can be attained by completing the 1 Hour Playtime counter found in the "My Info" tab.
Recipe will operate this way (using Vale Tudo as an example)

https://i.imgur.com/sDIvBXA.png
https://i.imgur.com/acf4c80.png

Select the Tome or Jade. A notice will come up if you would like to proceed and consume the Tome or Jade.
The Tome or Jade will randomly select a permanent or timed scroll, if you have multiples of the scroll.


Here is a complete list of all 68 Sacred Scrolls that are available for Ascension.

notes.title: [EVENT] Fashionista Tournament!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ckERyZ4.png 
Think you got the best outfit in town?  Let the community be the judge of that.


Objective:
Think you got the best looking outfit in game?  Join in on the first ever Rumble Fighter Fashionista Tournament! Post your best looking outfit in game, pretty it up with a little photo editing, and post it right here.  If you think you got what it takes, you may take the 1st place spot!

How it works:
The first 64 participants who post an outfit will be entered in a Fashionista showdown.  Your outfit will directly compete against one other person's outfit to move on to the next round.  Your outfit must follow all the rules to make it into the tournament.

You will only provide one outfit, and that one outfit will determine whether or not you make it or break it.

How will voting work:
Everyone can participate by voting.  Simply vote for the outfit you think looks better, provide your in game name, and you're complete until the next round.  Voting will take place in a "Google Form", so make sure to include your in game name.

Fashionista Rules:

Outfits created must be rated PG-13 or under.  Use common sense, but ultimately your outfit is subject to GM discretion.
Blatant copies of character designs from other franchises may result in a disqualification (example: Rock Lee from Naruto, Goku from Dragon Ball, and so on).
You must use items you already own.
You may edit your photos using Photoshop or any other photo editing software.  Free Photoshop alternatives can be found here: https://www.techradar.com/news/the-best-free-photoshop-alternative
You must list every single item used.
You must include your in game name in your entry.  If you do not want to include your in game name, please use the forum account associated with your Rumble Fighter account.  If for whatever reason, your forum account associated with your Rumble Fighter account is banned, you must provide your in game name, if you would like the prize.
If you are not part of the first 64, you still may submit an outfit for a "Fashionista Participation Prize".
All reservation posts will be deleted.

Voting Rules:

One person per vote.  If we catch multiple accounts, we may revoke the votes on our side.
You must vote on every single entry.
If you want the participation prize, you must provide your in game name.

Distribution & Distribution Rules:

You may not change your in game name until the prize is distributed.  If you change your in game name before then, your prize is forfeited.
Distribution will happen within 5 business days of the event ending.

Prizes:

1st Place: Fashion Master Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), 1000 RC, plus participation prize
2nd Place: Fashion King/Queen Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), plus participation prize
3rd/4th Place: Fashion Veteran Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), plus participation prize
5th - 64th Place: Participation Prize - Orichalcon Stone
Voting Participation Prize: Orichalcon Stone

notes.title: [EVENT] Guild Wars: The First Invitational
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/aFNrJt4.png

Guild Wars: The First Invitationals
Think you're the best Rumble Fighter leader in the world? Think again. Earn as much ladder points as you can, and if you're one of the highest ladder point earners, you will be selected in a small scale 3 vs 3 tournament.

Objective:
Earn as many ladder points as you can. If you are one of the top, you will be personally selected in a private 3 vs 3 guild tournament.

How do I get accepted?

Follow and abide to the rules listed below.
Individual players who earn the most amount of ladder points will be selected to choose 2 members from their guild to participate in the future guild tournament.
Only one team per guild.

Rules:

Your ladder point gain will be based on your end result, not your peak result. For example, if you start at 1000 ladder points, earn up to 1050, but drop down to 1025 by the end of the event, your ladder point gain is 25.
All players with suspicious ladder point gains will be investigated. Please do not cheat your way into this tournament.
Win trading, playing versus alternate accounts, and/or all other forms of ladder point boosting strategies are banned. We expect all participants to earn ladder points through hard fought games.
All reports of "DDoS" will be investigated and all violators will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.
The guild channel will be monitored privately and cheating players will be automatically disqualified. This will be done at the GMs discretion. Players will not be informed when they're being monitored and if they get disqualified until after the event is done.
You agree and will follow all RedFox Games terms and services.
You play with the upmost sportsmanship. It's a fighting game, some banter is allowed, but no serious insults.
If you are one of the selected participants to join the guild tournament, you may not join a guild that has an invite, unless you wish to forfeit your invite.
If you are one of the selected participants to join the guild tournament, you may join another guild that does not have an invite, but your selected teammates will have to join the different guild as well.
Forum Titles will go towards the forum account your Rumble Fighter character is connected to. If you have a main forum account separate from your Rumble Fighter account, you will not receive the forum title.
Grand Prize does not extend to chosen Team Mates.

The Level Up Boost Event has returned for player that missed the event previously! These are for all players below Lv. 25, new players, or returning players that wants to level up faster up to Lv. 25. 

Double EXP & Carat Event for ALL Players:

Sunday

Players can use 5 LV UP Tickets per day

The amount of RedFox Credits must be spent seen in the prize list.
RedFox Credits must be individually spent per account. You cannot combine two accounts spent to receive the rewards. RedFox Credits cannot be transferred to another account.
RedFox Credits that have been used to gift another user will have the RedFox Credits apply to the original purchaser for the event. For example, if you gifted a 1050 RedFox Credit item, only you will have 1050 RedFox Credits applied towards this event.

You cannot earn multiples of the event prize through this event.

Spend Rumble Fighter Carats in-game to reach the prize tiers.
Prizes/tiers are cumulative can only receive one item per tier.

notes.title: [EVENT] Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament Reloaded Sign Ups
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/f459d8e7941a0745ab0261d675e7ddbeb582b059.png
We have learned from our mistakes and want to bring the most exciting 1 vs 1 tournament to date.  Featured 1 vs 1 players will be personally invited.  Known players from far and wide will have their chance to take the trophy of the Rumble Royale Belt and Gladiator Set!  Will you have what it takes?

Tournament Sign Ups:
 1 vs 1 Sign Ups

How will I be chosen?
Featured 1 vs 1 players will be contacted via e-mail by an official @playredfox.com e-mail and forum PM.  You will only have to respond to one or the other.  If you have not been featured, you can increase your chances by:

Increase your in game activity in the next 7 days
Known and vouched as a great 1 vs 1 player by the members of the community
Known and vouched for as a great player in general by the members of the community

The rest will be randomly selected.  There will be 64 participants.

How will I know I have been chosen?
You will be e-mailed by an official @playredfox.com e-mail.

Sign Up Dates:
Until August 19th, 11:59:59 PST

Tournament Rules:

Sacred Scrolls Ban List: All scrolls that are not sold in the shop are banned except Fearless, Telos, Sumo, and Hung Gar.
No ExoCores can be used.
All active pouch items cannot be used such as but not limited to: all kinds of potions, Panic Attack +1, and all kinds of bombs.
All passive pouch items that enhance fighting ability cannot be used such as but not limited to: eye of critical damage and magic runes.
Avalon Drivers cannot be used.
Back guard items cannot be used.
Rebirth Passives can be used.
Stalling tactics such as excessively running away or constant hit and run tactics will result in a round forfeit (up to the GM discretion).
You will not be limited to one scroll.  You will be able to switch scrolls in between matches.  Each match is 3 rounds.
All matches up to the semi finals will be Best of 3 Rounds.
Semi Finals will feature a "first to 3 rounds".  The winner will be decided who wins 3 rounds first.
Finals will feature a "first to 9 rounds".  The winner will be decided who wins 9 rounds first.
Stat limits:


STR, ARM, SPD, JMP must be 30 or below
HP must be 3000 or below
Critical can be used, but only up to 100.

General Rules:

No trash talk and keep flaming to a minimum.  We understand this is a fighting game, but tilt tactics are not allowed.
In game name changes after you have signed up will forfeit any prizes or qualification into the tournament.  Once you receive your prizes, you may change your in game name as usual though.
Cheating in any form will result in automatic disqualification and removal of your prizes on your account, and in some instances may result in a ban.  Cheating is, but not limited to: any form of hacking, having another player log into your account to 1 vs 1 for you, using hacked or exploited item sets or stats.
You may not vouch for yourself.  If you're great at something, they will tell you.

Tournament Format:
1 vs 1, Single Elimination

Tournament Schedule:
August 20th: Top 64, 2:30 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 21st - Top 64 Continued, 2:30 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 22nd - Top 32, 3:00 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 23rd - Top 16, 3:00 PM PST to 6:00 PM PST
August 24th - Quarter Finals, 3:00 PM PST to 5:00 PM PST
August 25th - Semi Finals & Finals, 4:00 PM PST to END

We are introducing a New Level Up Boost Event for all players below Lv. 25, new players, or returning players that wants to level up faster up to Lv. 25.

You can literally just do one additional round of game to earn +1 EXP point to get to the next level

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/f46b30c04453a9c7305e36d4870b2a69a6767b27.png
Show us your feats of strength by showcasing your skills in Rumble Fighter! We can’t wait to see some amazing video showcase!

Players must feature themselves in a video performing something amazing in Rumble Fighter. Some examples are:

Beating a user in a 1 vs 1 without jumping, grabbing, running punch, running kick, or jump attacks
Knocking off every person off Moonlight Valley without grabbing or running punch
Defeating 1 vs 4 without using ExoCores or hit and run tactics
Juggling an opponent from one side of the map to another
Using new game mechanics like Brave Mode comeback and winning the match

You will not be limited to these examples and we ask you to be creative. The more creative and unique entries will have a higher chance of winning.

Rules:

Players must showcase Feats of strength, the more amazing or difficult the feat, the better your chances on getting the grand prize.
Your video must clearly show your in game name and user interface to prevent identity fraud.
You may not use hacks or 3rd party programs that enhance your game play, stats, or physics of the game. It may be subject to review and punishment.
Your video must be uploaded either on YouTube or Vimeo
Your entry must be signed by your in game name in your entry post.
If you change your in game name before the prize distribution, you forfeit in game prizes rewarded.
Participation prize will be graded by effort, but ideally you will prove that you can do more than just record a match it has to be something that shows an amazing feat.
If you have more than one existing forum title, you may have to remove a forum title to make room for the new one
In game footage must be recorded in the currently Rumble Fighter client or not previously recorded in the past.
Prizes are not tiered. You will only get the prize in your tier either Grand Prize or Participation Prizes.

Prizes:
Grand Prize: 2000 RC, Director’s Title, “I Am Strong!” Forum Title
Participation Prizes: 500 RC (Video entries is subject for review to receive the Participation Prize)

Event Period: July 20, 2018 00:00 PDT – July 31, 2018 23:59 PDT

Prize Distribution: TBA

Note thread is subject to change

notes.title: July 2018 First Update
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/Sqg2yO6.png
Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes were made this maintenance.

Most of the July 1st update is about introducing several new gameplay mechanics that have been added in game including Air Forward-Roll Function and Brave Mode in all modes of in game. There are also some new RE Scrolls: The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE added (Super Arts Function) Check out the Gameplay Section below for more in-depth details.

http://i.imgur.com/ADNGkt9.png
July 2018 1st Update is here! We have new gameplay mechanics added to the game with the Air Forward-Roll Function and Brave Mode.

There is also an updated The Blue Dragon Scroll RE and White Tiger Scroll RE that has exclusive Super Arts function. Check out the Video preview of these new features:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/be8ecbf9b2fb0d513772887533e4adfcf643ebb7.png

The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE:
The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE are both available at the store with packaged Orichalcon.

If you already have the normal Blue Dragon Scroll or White Tiger Scroll, Players can also upgrade/obtain these RE scrolls via Combination Formula in which they can obtain combination material through A Trip to the Graveyard Boss Mode!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/d4ec8646bd94efe8e799cf47b2b6ba952213529d.png

Medal Shop has been updated to include these Ticket Items that can be used to combine with Orichalcon to receive 1 of the current sale boxes or an exclusive Orichalcon ExoCore and Scroll Box
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e5c7b47edf574e6f131b7bf6bd2f715eac263a20.png

For further Orichalcon formulas and Box contents, head to  What's New? 

Orichalcon: Can be earned through Login Attendance Event or you can purchase the White Tiger RE Package and The Blue Dragon RE Package which contains 7x Orichalcon on each package.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/26bef34e9c0ae02e24a54d0e1ad1da6f8e9040d5.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/d80d4cef54c63db608395ccc724777ca42a9a52c.png

White Tiger RE Package: Contains the White Tiger RE Scroll + 7 Orichalcon
The Blue Dragon RE Package: Contains the Blue Dragon RE Scroll + 7 Orichalcon


Tempest Package is now available in the store for a limited time

Metatron – Vermillion Phoenix Box and Packages are back available on sale for a limited time

South Guardian Metatron Box – Vermillion Phoenix
South Guardian Metatron 5 Package – Vermillion Phoenix

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e2269c8bbdf12bd80789f475c1c37d5551725566.png

New user based designed scroll Heartseeker is still available at the store. Congrats to the Scroll Design Winner: @Shana
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/aa3810c7facd70d58b80eafcbdbd36f42ca835cc.png

Since we have a Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament coming up, we have compiled some New Tournament Packages available at the store with a great discounted prices plus a bonus item.

http://i.imgur.com/7P03m5h.png
New Air Forward-Roll Function:
Ability to control the posture when being attacked (Mid-air).

Condition Requirements:

Must have an extra Panic Attack remaining
Click P + K (Panic Attack command) simultaneously while attacked in the mid-air transition of jump and down attack.


New Gameplay Mechanics Added:
Brave Mode:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/329b2f1867bd78e8bc6fb3f1669b38f6f68b03af.png
Once your HP start flickering there is an automatic attack boost so you can decide to be brave and risky. You will still need to be skillful at attacking since your health is still 15%, but this will allow you to possibly make a comeback win.
Condition Requirements:

HP must be lower than 15%
Panic/Dying Condition (HP lower than 15%) – HP will be flickering.
Attack hit will increase (Attack Boost) (Auto active. Regardless of class or level)

Super Arts Function (The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE Exclusive):
Able to cast special attack to inflict great damage without transforming into an ExoCore.
Condition Requirements:

Must meet the Guardian requirement
Equip a scroll Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE to cast Super Arts
Brave Mode (HP lower than 15%)
Can only be used 1x per Round
Hit "B" to execute the Super Arts

Other Fixes:
Scroll-Heartseeker: Attack range of combos is expanded (KKK, KKK+G)
Andro: An issue of unable to heal/recover upon the occurrence of Overheat (while transformed) is fixed
Scroll- Volt: An issue of grab has fixed


Note: Brave Mode will end if the Super Arts is being used while HP is lower than 15% (regardless of it being successful or failed attempt)
Super Arts is a Function that the developers are still developing possibly for other scrolls in the future. Let us know what you think of these additional gameplay mechanics and changes.

http://i.imgur.com/58vJEzF.png
Let us know what you think of these gameplay mechanic changes. You can always send us some feedback by sending us a support ticket for full details. Thanks everyone we hope that you like the new game mechanics.

http://i.imgur.com/0pqopyx.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/0f04f2477eaa5a6fb9e0b216e32a5fafb844f818.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/05462718bdd31f0090b7922ec0b3f9e5100f569d.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e9481fffac294f20f5f2bca06ec25f53b550427e.png

notes.title: [NOTICE] Network Maintenance: July 10, 2018 (02:00AM - 06:00AM PDT)
notes.content:
Hello Rumble Fighter Community,

We will undergo a network maintenance beginning at July 10, 2018 02:00 (2:00 AM PDT) It is expected to last for at least 4 hours until 6:00AM PDT.

As we have announced there were some issues with server stability that has resulted in numerous amount players disconnecting from Rumble Fighter. This issue was caused by DDoS attacks on our servers affecting all of our games. As a response, we will be implementing new system on the servers to hopefully prevent these DDoS attacks and stabilize our network servers.

During this period the servers will be open, but will be unstable. If you are disconnected from Rumble Fighter, simply restart and log back into the game. The servers will stay online for the remainder of the network maintenance duration. 

 Network Maintenance Duration:
Tuesday, July 10, 2018 at 02:00 AM (2:00AM) PDT - Tuesday July 10, 2018 at 06:00 AM (6:00AM) PDT

We apologize in advance for any inconvenience. Thank you for understanding the situation.

notes.title: [EVENT] Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament Qualification Event
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/0b52bbd547b5e6f5b4b7771cb72a4835f8e944d7.png
Summer is just getting started, so lets kick up the heat with another tournament!  Individual skill is what it is all about.  Prepare yourself for the ultimate 1 vs 1 tournament of the year.  The grand prize will contain the legendary "Gladiator Set".  Do you even have what it takes to qualify?


Event Qualification Dates:
July 6th, 2018 - July 15th, 2018

Event Qualification Requirements:
This 1 vs 1 tournament will not have any formal sign ups.  Fighters will have to complete a set of tasks in game to be considered.

You must play 100 rounds of "True Battle Mode" or "Battle Mode" in a 1 vs 1 setting.
You may play on any map, however the following maps will be taken into higher consideration: "Dungeon", "Rumble Dojo", and "Blacktop Melee".
You may play with stats, items, runes, ExoCores, and etc. but we recommend you do not.  We intend for this tournament to be all about skill.
You may use any and all scrolls, however the following scrolls will be banned in the actual tournament: (Tentative) Sage Master & all its variants.

How will participants be chosen?
Fighters who fulfill the event qualification requirements will be selectively selected to participate in the 1 vs 1 tournament.  Fighters will have been selected for the tournament will receive an e-mail notification to their account.  The e-mail will be sent to the e-mail their account is registered with.  Additionally, in game names of all the selected applicants will be posted in the next post.

Rules and Guidelines:
Rules and guidelines are subject to change at any given moment.  Rules will not be retroactively applied unless within reason.  By participating in this tournament, you acknowledge and agree to all the rules and guidelines listed in this tournament.  In addition, you agree to all of RedFox Games terms & service and all Rumble Fighter general rules and guidelines.  Failure to comply with everything listed will result in disqualification, removal from the prize list, and/or a potential ban.

You must be level 15 or above and have the "Guardian Gem" in your inventory.  If you are level 15 and higher and are unable to get the Guardian Gem, please send a ticket to the help desk.  If you can use your "nanmu", you have the Guardian Gem.
You will have to register your scroll for the first round of the tournament.  Once this scroll is registered, this will be the only scroll you can use for the duration of the tournament.
For the whole duration of the tournament, all stats and items are banned.  The only items and passives allowed to influence your characters fighting ability are: your sacred scroll, your base class, and your rebirth passive.
You may change your character look using "Avatar" but you must replace stat items with no stat items in your "Build-Up" section.
Sacred Scroll Ban List: (Tentative) Sage Master & all its variants.
Cheating, multiple entries, playing on multiple accounts,intentional disconnections, or having someone play on your account will be on grounds for immediate disqualification. If your account is found to have engaged in any of these activities, even after the tournament is over, your prizes will be revoked and you will be disqualified from future tournaments for the next 3 months.
Any form of hacking, hacked gems or gemstones used in the tournament will result in an immediate disqualification without appeal. Users will have to submit evidence regarding this. Edited and cropped screenshots will not be allowed as evidence.
Any evidence of stalling or abuse of hit and run tactics will disqualify the team (only applicable in the main tournament).
The tournament will be done in a single elimination format.
In game name changes will result an immediate disqualification and forfeit of all prizes.


For further information regarding this tournament, please head to our forums

notes.title: [EVENT] Uniquely You - The Guessing Game!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/6ad0a602271867e0b25f2a03d519bca31d5bef48.png

Special thanks to @M4cropod and @IWavyI for suggesting this event.

Rules:
You must understand the context of this event: http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-uniquely-you.31750/
Correctly guess the winning numbers for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place to receive the SAME prize!
Your guess must not be edited. All edited posts will be removed.
Your guess must be the EXACT number. Closest guess does not get the prize!
You cannot guess the same number someone else has already guessed.
Posts will be considered in chronological order. If someone guesses 3 today, and someone else guesses 3 tomorrow, the second person's entry will not count.
One entry per user. If we find that you are using multiple accounts to make guesses, you will be disqualified.
It is possible that this event could have no winners.
If you correctly guess two place's numbers, you will only receive the "higher tier" prize.
Example: First place's end score is 2, third place's end score is 90. You guessed 2, 30, 90. You will only receive the first place prize.
You must post your IGN and let us know which guess is for which place.

Ready to make your best guess? POST YOUR ENTRY BELOW!

Example post format:
"Hey wassup i'm havin' me self a nice coffee dis morning, here's my guesses for 1st, 2nd, and tird place! ^0^
1st Place - 10 kills
2nd Place - 58 kills
3rd Place - 9999 kills"

BAD example post format: “10 999 19 lmao”

Prizes:
If you correctly guess 1st place - Dark Haze Ninjitsu G2S
If you correctly guess 2nd place - Dark Haze Ninjitsu G2S (30 day) x2
If you correctly guess 3rd place - Dark Haze Ninjitsu G2S (30 day)


Event Duration: February 10, 2017 - February 13, 2017 12:00 PST
Prize Distribution: TBA

Note: This thread is subject to change.

notes.title: [Notice] Steam Launch Issue
notes.content:
Hello Rumble Fighters,

We are currently investigating the Steam Launch issue.

We have gathered files from affected players to try to locate a pattern to locate the issue.

Previously, some players who have reported the issue are now able to access the game through Steam. If you are one of these players, please share how you were able to resolve the issue.

Our other suggestions to attempt if you are still experiencing this issue:

1. Restart the Steam client in Administrator Mode.

2. Re-install Rumble Fighter:
To do this, visit your Steam Library, right click Rumble Fighter and select "Properties". Click the "Local Files" tab and click "Delete Local Game Content". Afterwards, re-install Rumble Fighter.

3. Compatibility:
Right click on Steam.exe (Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".

Right click on rumblefighter.exe (Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RumbleFighter) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".

Right click on RumbleLauncher.exe (Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RumbleFighter) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".

notes.title: Connecting RedFox Games' Rumble Fighter to Steam
notes.content:
RedFox Games' Rumble Fighter will be available through Steam starting December 16, 2016 at 11:00 PST. Follow this quick guide to connect your RedFox Games account to Steam!

==========NOTICE=============
Once you have connected your RedFox Games account to a Steam account, it cannot be un-linked, so please make note of this!
==============================

1. Download Rumble Fighter from Steam.

2. Go to your Library and click "PLAY".
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/31437f1cda0eb003428f0f7209f99556178c5a66.png

3. A login box will appear. Type in your RedFox Games account information and click "LOGIN".
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/a207ff8e98551b1700302f2129f3d97278718603.png

4. Rumble Fighter will then launch the launcher to check for any patches. Note: Please allow the launcher to complete patching before moving on to the next step.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/08d3558324fa2ad7d07187c88dc36585bbf70062.png

And you're done! Enjoy!


Logging onto Rumble Fighter through Steam afterwards:
After you have connected your account, you will only need to launch Rumble Fighter from Steam. Your client will automatically patch and log you into the game. Super easy!

If you need assistance with any portion of the installation process, don't be afraid to send a help desk ticket.
